driver: experiments/repro_second_lane_k9.py (new file; does NOT import the original k9_sparse_reward_redesign.py)
expectation: BOUND STANDS replicates (fail of the lift, same as original).
gate: Original K9 gate applied per seed: WIN iff R = total_reward(learned) / total_reward(frozen) >= 1.30. Replication verdict: BOUND STANDS (reproduces) iff wins <= 1/4; OVERTURNED (bound lifts, a finding) iff wins >= 3/4; 2/4 = INCONCLUSIVE.
hypothesis: The K9 verdict (BOUND STANDS / NR-A-011: the return-conditioned baseline-free eligibility-trace gain redesign fails to lift the NR-A-006 delayed_reward bound) replicates on fresh seeds with an independently written driver.
lane: second_lane (independent driver, rewritten from the published spec; only the architecture modules under test are imported)
null: The K9 verdict does not replicate: the bound lifts on fresh seeds (the original 0/4 was a seeding/single-driver artifact). A non-replication in either direction is reported as such.
preregistered_before: any implementation or execution of the second-lane K9 driver

protocol.frozen_condition: identical SparseRewardArbitrator with frozen=True (gains pinned at 1.0)
protocol.metric: R = total_reward(learned) / total_reward(frozen) per seed; per-seed WIN iff R >= 1.30
protocol.specialists: neutral (0.5 + noise(0.05); bandit isolation, same as K5 P1)

reproduction_rule.note: 4-seed adaptation of the >=4/5 rule: 3/4 per-seed wins reproduces a win/lift verdict; <=1/4 reproduces a bound-stands verdict.
reproduction_rule.reproduces: verdict identity holds: BOUND STANDS again (wins <= 1/4)

seed_disjointness: All four replication seeds are distinct from the original K9 seed set and from every other known flesh-pits seed series.
